# UKApi.co.uk

> A UK data API for developers. UKApi.co.uk normalises postcode, council, calendar, company, crime, flood, food hygiene and MOT history data into a consistent versioned API.

## Public resources

- [API catalogue](https://ukapi.co.uk/api-catalogue): Available endpoint families and coverage.
- [Documentation](https://ukapi.co.uk/docs): Authentication, request format, response format and endpoint reference.
- [Pricing](https://ukapi.co.uk/pricing): Plans and monthly request quotas.
- [Data sources](https://ukapi.co.uk/data-sources): Upstream sources, attribution, coverage and limitations.
- [Service status](https://ukapi.co.uk/status): Current configured service availability.
- [Terms of Use](https://ukapi.co.uk/terms): Terms for accounts and API access.
- [Paid Plan Terms](https://ukapi.co.uk/paid-plan-terms): Paid subscriptions, billing, cancellation and refunds.
- [Privacy Notice](https://ukapi.co.uk/privacy): How UKApi handles personal information.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://ukapi.co.uk/acceptable-use): Security, fair-use and conduct rules.

## MOT history endpoints

- `GET /v1/mot/registration/{registration}`: Vehicle details and MOT history by registration.
- `GET /v1/mot/vin/{vin}`: Vehicle details and MOT history by 17-character VIN.

These endpoints use the DVSA MOT History API and cover Great Britain and Northern Ireland. They return the standard `data` and `meta` envelope and require the normal UKApi Bearer API key.

## Geography and calendar endpoints

- `GET /v1/outcodes/{outcode}`: Outcode centre and administrative references.
- `GET /v1/councils/postcode/{postcode}`: Resolve a local authority district from a postcode.
- `GET /v1/councils/{code}`: Look up an ONS local authority district code.
- `GET /v1/bank-holidays`: Bank holidays for all UK divisions.
- `GET /v1/bank-holidays/{division}`: Bank holidays for one division.
- `GET /v1/working-days?from=&to=&division=`: Bounded weekday and public-holiday calculation.
- `GET /v1/tax-years/current` and `GET /v1/tax-years/{year}`: UK tax-year calendar boundaries, not tax advice.

Geography uses Postcodes.io and a versioned ONS local-authority reference. Bank
holidays use the GOV.UK calendar. Coverage, freshness and source terms are
documented on the catalogue and data-sources pages.

## Food hygiene endpoints

- `GET /v1/food-establishments/{id}`: One food establishment record.
- `GET /v1/food-establishments/search`: Search by name or postcode, with explicit FHRS/FHIS and rating filters.
- `GET /v1/food-establishments/nearby`: Search participating authorities near a postcode within a bounded radius.

Food hygiene data comes from the Food Standards Agency ratings service. FHRS
and FHIS are preserved as distinct scheme values, coverage depends on
participating local authorities, and ordinary results may be cached for up to
six hours. The endpoint does not provide emergency advice or imply FSA or
local-authority affiliation.

## Planning constraints

- `GET /v1/planning/constraints?postcode=...`: Curated planning constraints for an England postcode.
- `GET /v1/planning/constraints?lat=...&lng=...`: The same lookup using WGS84 coordinates.

The current curated set covers conservation areas, listed buildings, green
belts, Article 4 direction areas and tree preservation zones. Planning Data is
England-only, incomplete and still in development. Responses include
dataset-specific licence, attribution and limitation metadata. An empty result
is not proof that no constraint exists, and this endpoint is not an official
property search.

## Notes

UKApi.co.uk is an independent developer service and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the UK Government. Consult the data-sources page for source-specific coverage, freshness and terms.
